measurements: Navigation-relative performance.now() milliseconds from manually held source experiments. Medians and ranges describe these runs; they are not field performance estimates. Keyboard measurement is when a synthetic Ctrl+K opened the actual search input after the source observation; onboarding uses an actual focus and click followed by a changed step. The eligible route timestamp bounds the receipt of the injected breaking event. Whole-wave promises intentionally remain held until after observations. NWS and breaking-news are separate paths.
fixtures: Production full application entry, layout and acquisition scheduler. Instrumented guarded leaves settle synthetically except held news and the real NWS pipeline supplied isolated response bodies. Cold uses a fresh profile with a known completed onboarding decision. Warm reloads that same profile. A separate first-run case does not seed onboarding. Web uses Chromium with WebGL unavailable (supported SVG fallback), isolated localhost assets, intercepted external requests and disabled SW/HTTP cache. Desktop uses the true Tauri runtime and incognito WKWebView in a signed uninstalled QA host with actual vault intro, local assets and tightened test-egress CSP. Stubbed native invoke, fetch, audio, browser Notification and no configured relay. No physical delivery, real providers, field timing or installed profile tested.
warnings: Fresh verified means the real normalized fixture is retained in the unified store with nonexpired nws-expiry evidence and the real NWS panel receives it. Malformed/unavailable/cached have an errored freshness state. Main-based NWS handling can still display an expired warning row (expiry predates response); it is not fresh evidence for a current threat. Structural completeness/dismissal belongs to held UX-047. An eligible breaking event is a separate synthetic ingress, verified at transport capture, not a real warning transmission.
harnessIssues: Initial Chromium baseline with software WebGL timed out in its 120 s bound under concurrent CPU/GPU load; second diagnostic run was stopped. Recorded measurements for both revisions use the same intentionally WebGL-disabled Chrome configuration.
Initial candidate build probe anchored on the pre-refactor router assignment. Rebuilt with the anchor on the same call, which is unique in both trees. Neither issue is a passing sample.

independentKeyboardTiming.qualifier: Companion input-first experiment. Each fresh browser process/context has onboarding marked complete to test an eligible workspace. Poll (35 ms target, event loop permitting) for the existing phase-5 events/URL wiring breadcrumb, which follows registration of search keyboard listeners. On desktop also wait for the actual vault DOM removal. Synchronously dispatch the Ctrl+K event and poll the real search DOM; neither attempt nor observed response waits for NWS, news completion, or the App.init promise. These times are the first triggered/observed action in this fixture, not an exact lower bound on input or physical key latency. News remains held until after keyboard/search, current NWS and an independent eligible route inspection. Timing may vary under concurrent builds.
